description: This Dart source file defines the `FolderRepository` class, which provides CRUD operations for folder entities stored in a database. It manages folder data via the `AppDatabase` class, emits change events through a broadcast stream, and supports folder creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and search functionalities.

classes.name: FolderRepository
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations and change notifications for folders stored in the database.

classes.name: FolderChange
classes.description: Represents a change event (create, update, delete) for a folder, used for broadcasting updates.

classes.name: FolderChangeType
classes.description: Enumeration of the types of folder change events.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder record in the database and emits a creation event.

methods.name: getFolderById
methods.description: Retrieves a folder by its ID.

methods.name: getAllFolders
methods.description: Retrieves all folders ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates folder details and emits an update event.

methods.name: deleteFolder
methods.description: Deletes a folder by ID and emits a delete event.

methods.name: searchByName
methods.description: Searches folders by a name query using a LIKE SQL clause.
